title: Polynomial-time binary comparison language
statement: For a bit string $z$, let $a$ and $b$ be the two components parsed from $z$, taking both to be the empty string if parsing fails, and interpret each bit string as a binary numeral with its first bit least significant. The language of strings for which the value of $a$ is at most the value of $b$ belongs to $P$.
